note: The releases cut before #6642, newest first, and frozen: nothing adds to this file. A release since is an annotated tag `v<version>` on the forge's own repository whose message is its record, `{ "version", "migrations", "ids" }` (`bun scripts/cut-release.ts <version>` writes it; src/release/shipped.ts reads both). `migrations` counts the migration ids a release applied, and `ids` names the stamped ones among them, every file past 0090 by its name without .ts; a release from before #1837 has a count only: the first that many numbered files. test/schema-additive.test.ts holds every migration not in both of the two newest releases here to additive (notAdditive in src/kernel/migrate.ts). Pins are not the release's: each pull pins its own migration (`bun scripts/pin-migrations.ts`, src/core/migration-pins/).
